network_status.network: Evento alluvionale del 13-15 luglio 2002 - effetti al suolo
network_status.summary_it: Il record identifica il Gesso a Roccavione, ma la fonte ufficiale colloca il ponte travolto sul Vermenagna, circa 500 m a monte della confluenza nel Gesso. Nessun dato del Gesso viene trasferito.
network_status.summary_en: The record identifies the Gesso at Roccavione, but the official source places the swept-away bridge on the Vermenagna about 500 m upstream of its confluence with the Gesso. No Gesso value is transferred.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
